title: Regression: Inventory page at 1366×768 scrolls only the table and the toolbar wraps at 1024 px
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. The Active tab holds more parts than fit on screen (e.g. the 201 QAPL-CAP parts). Chrome window sizes 1366×768, 1024 and 375 available. 375 px is not a supported layout (FF-1: parts management is desktop and tablet only): smoke only, do not file layout defects at that width.
custom_steps:
1. Set the window to 1366×768 and open /parts/inventory on the Active tab.
  2. Scroll inside the table until more rows load, then try to scroll the page itself with the pointer over the title and toolbar.
  3. Click the Inactive tab.
  4. Set the window width to 1024 px.
  5. Set the window width to 375 px and click the Active and Inactive tabs.
custom_expected:
1. The page is one viewport-high column: exactly one scrollbar shows, the table's; the page itself does not scroll.
  2. Only the table scrolls and loads more rows; the title, tabs and toolbar stay in place; the page body does not scroll.
  3. No page scrollbar appears; the inactive rows sit at the top of the table and no no-data row is parked at the bottom.
  4. The toolbar (search, filter chips, ⋮, New Inventory Part, Column Selection) wraps onto further lines without overlapping; the tabs stay on their own line under the title.
  5. Smoke only: the page scrolls and both tabs are reachable and switch the list.
